lernapps.github.io.message:
feat(nav): Konzepte (/docs/) as its own entry of the header

## Intent

The docs are the way into the concepts behind lernapps.net and its tooling: vision, organisation, platform design. They should be easy to find from every page.

## Key changes

- The header gets the entry "Konzepte" (en "Concepts") for /docs/, after Features.
- The footer link to the docs goes, so the link is not there twice.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The other sites show the entry once they move to this site frame. The new tooling start page is tooling dec3530.

tooling.message:
feat(site): start page with the workshop first, then prompt engineering, architecture and GitHub

## Intent

The tooling's start page should be inviting and lead with what matters most, the workshop. The tooling site should also be part of the global navigation.

## Key changes

- The start page gets the look of the workshop page: a dark hero and the workshop as the one big card with the phases of the plan, rendered from workshop.yaml.
- Three cards follow for prompt engineering, architecture and GitHub, then a band that leads to the docs for the concepts behind it, and a reference list of rules, schemas, llms.txt and source.
- The site frame moves to the current main of lernapps.github.io, whose header has Tooling.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The docs entry of the header comes with lernapps.github.io aaf4a36.
